args.body:
File: src/util/upload.ts

Windows line endings (CRLF) keep the trailing carriage return on the header row, making every data row fail column count comparison against the header. Trim trailing carriage returns when splitting lines so CSVs exported from Windows parse successfully.
args.title: Fix line ending handling in src/util/upload.ts
